name: index_momentum_stock_selection_5s
author: adapted from claude_strategist
thesis: When Nifty50 has strong intraday momentum (return from open > 0.5% by 10:00), the highest-beta stocks in the index tend to amplify this move for the rest of the day. By going long the top 5 highest-beta Nifty50 stocks on bullish index days (and short top 5 on bearish days), you lever up the index momentum through beta. The stock selection based on beta creates ~1.5x leverage without using derivatives. Edge persists because computing real-time beta-sorted portfolios and executing quickly requires automation.
mechanism: Multiple independent signals confirming the same direction increase the probability that a genuine order flow imbalance exists, not just noise. When momentum, volume, and volatility signals align, it indicates that institutional activity is creating measurable market impact across multiple dimensions simultaneously, increasing the confidence of directional prediction.

indicators.name: beta_rank
indicators.formula: rank of rolling_beta_20day descending among Nifty50 stocks

filters.volume_filter: all 5 stocks must have > SMA(volume, 20) by 10:00

weaknesses: 5 simultaneous positions = 5x brokerage cost (₹200 just for entry)
Beta estimates are backward-looking — a stock's beta today may differ from its 20-day historical beta
On index reversal days, all 5 stocks reverse together = correlated losses
prior_art: Beta-momentum strategy — factor investing concept applied intraday
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
